incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated embeddings write traffic detected from proxy pool. QPS 10.8k (baseline ~800). 5xx rising to 7.4%. Paging on-call @lee-oncall
lee-oncall: Ack. Pulling logs and dashboards https://internal.redwood/ops/dashboards/embeds-proxy. Who's on edge/WAF?
zara-sre: I'm looking at connection groups. Large fanout from identical token prefix and short inter-request intervals. APAC edges hit first. Sample header: ```src=203.0.113.55 ua="curl/7.79" token_prefix=proxy_7c4 path=/v1/embeddings```
nikhil-infra: Recommend 3-step immediate mitigation: 1) Edge WAF challenge for fingerprinted UA/token headers 2) Create dynamic quota slice for tokens matching "^proxy_" 3) Soft-disable batch embeddings to stop amplification
maya-sec: Agreed. Also spool a captcha/challenge for suspicious geos (APAC + LATAM) and add token hash denylist if repeated. We should avoid full IP blocks unless necessary.
lee-oncall: Nikhil please apply WAF challenge and quota. Taylor, prepare customer impact list for CX. Olga, draft a short status.
nikhil-infra: Applying WAF rule: `/wafctl rule apply --name proxy-fingerprint-challenge --match "ua:curl|python-requests|token_prefix:proxy_" --action challenge --scope global`
infra-bot: WAF rule proxy-fingerprint-challenge applied. First 30s matches: 24% of surge traffic.
nikhil-infra: Creating quota slice: `redwoodctl quota create --name proxy-slice-171234 --match "token:^proxy_" --rate 3r/s --burst 6 --ttl 90s` Propagating to edge.
taylor-support: Pulling affected customers now. Found 6 customers with >4% errors, 2 merchants with immediate 5xx spikes. Preparing outreach for top 2.
nikhil-infra: Toggling batch embeddings feature flag to limit amplification: `REDWOOD_FEATURE_BATCH_EMBEDS=false` rolling to 30% then 100%. Expect QPS to drop in ~40s.
zara-sre: Metrics update: QPS dropping from 10.8k -> 2.9k after WAF+quota+flag. 5xx down to 2.9%. Memory pressure easing on embed nodes.
olga-cx: Draft status (short): "We observed elevated request volume affecting embeddings. Edge mitigations are in place and we're monitoring. Some API requests may return transient errors. We'll update in 30 minutes." Want to send?
lee-oncall: Send now. Keep messaging conservative: "mitigations applied" and "investigating root cause".
maya-sec: Saving matchsets to case /cases/proxy-fanout-171234. Advise token rotation for any tokens that show repeated matches. Also collect UA and path patterns for follow-up rules.
nikhil-infra: Added geo challenge for APAC/LATAM ranges and created denylist for top 20 abusive proxies. Command: `/wafctl denylist add --name proxy-top20 --ips-file /tmp/abusive_ips.txt`
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2024171234999. Severity S2. Link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-2024171234999
lee-oncall: Handoff plan: I'll stay for 20m to ensure stability, then hand to @zara-sre for monitoring and postmortem. Key logs to include in postmortem: matched token hashes, UA patterns, edge latency timeline, customer impact matrix.
zara-sre: Accepted handoff. I'll start drafting a short runbook for future attacks (quota slice template, WAF match regex, FF toggle steps).
taylor-support: Notified top 2 customers with targeted message and posted status update. CX monitoring shows errors decreasing for most affected.
nikhil-infra: Note: saw a small regression when rolling FF to 100% at 70% rollout stage -> reverted to 80% then ramped slowly. Keeping a canary rate next time.
lee-oncall: Final note before handoff: keep an eye on any new token prefixes, captcha failure rate, and any customer tokens that were whitelisted. If 5xx creeps above 4% again we escalate to S1 and page infra-eng. Signing out at 1712350200.
incident-bot: Last update logged 1712350198. Monitoring continues.
